name: Enforce the team's approval policy
description: The review policy is read from the review block of .lastro/config.json: approvals, how many distinct reviewers must approve each intent (default 1, never less than 1), and submitterCanApprove (default true); the legacy requiredApprovals key is still read as approvals, and createLastro takes the same policy. The LLM that extracted the intents is their author and every person is a reviewer, the submitter included; with submitterCanApprove false the submitter's approvals do not count. An approved or amended intent counts its distinct counting approvers; proposed and rejected intents count zero. pending() lists every proposed intent with no approval as not reviewed, every non-rejected intent below the policy with how many approvals it still needs, every unanswered decision and every open thread. A proposal records the policy it was reviewed under, so a later change to the config never turns an approved proposal into an unapproved one or the reverse. Rejected intents never block.
